claims.rationale: The clonazepam boxed warning says benzodiazepines with opioids may cause profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma and death, and buprenorphine is an opioid.
The French Rivotril label names buprenorphine substitution treatment with an increased, possibly fatal, respiratory depression risk; the English rendering is faithful.

The rat abstract does report raised PaCO2 with buprenorphine plus high-dose clonazepam, but its overall conclusion is that pharmacological-dose combinations had no significant effect beyond buprenorphine alone, which the claim leaves out.
